**Finding: compliant** (rule MINCOMMIT — no redline proposed).

The Development and Option Agreement contains no take-or-pay or minimum-volume obligation on AbbVie:

- **Payments are event/usage based** — a $30M upfront (§6.1), non-refundable milestones payable only "after the achievement of each of the following milestones" (§6.2), and royalties on Net Sales; no minimum annual royalty or shortfall/penalty mechanic.
- **No purchase obligation** — §4.5.1 gives AbbVie the *sole right* to Manufacture or have Manufactured and supply commercial product, so we are not locked into buying volumes from Harpoon; §§4.5.2–4.5.3 impose technology-transfer duties on Harpoon in our favour.
- **Keyword sweeps** for "minimum", "shortfall", "take or pay", "commit to purchase", "minimum royalty" surfaced only insurance coverage limits (§11.6), and diligence/commercially reasonable efforts undertakings are not minimum commitments under this rule.

This sits at the preferred position, so no edit is warranted.
